text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few months after <chrname> entered the Senior Class...
The atmosphere among the public had begun to shift once more.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text: "The 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'? What's that?"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's the pinnacle of racing in the world.
A historic French GⅠ race where
many legendary Umamusume have claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Who from Japan has won it?
Quite a lot of them go overseas, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...No one.
Not a single Japanese Umamusume has won it yet."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Voices
text_block_list.text:
"—My fave had such an amazing race the other day...
I really want her to take on the world!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the charm of Umamusume rising and the thrills of racing becoming widely known,
I was pondering what theme to focus on next, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Taking on the world" might be fitting.
Just as I was thinking that,
I received a call from Speed Symboli.
choice_data_list: A special feature on overseas races?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll be doing a live stream in a talk-show format with guests,
reflecting on history as we go.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now that the domestic champion has been decided,
the topic bound to draw the most interest next is... challenging overseas.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Producing results on the world stage will capture the public's attention.
And it will surely ignite even greater passion among the fans.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the world
will yield great returns for the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I figured there would be high expectations, especially for the girls who've captured so much fan support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Speed Symboli's glance,
I could feel her feelings toward <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing <chrname>'s recent success, they seemed to reach out to me, her Trainer, hoping it might offer some insight for setting a new goal.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We've set aside some time after the event, so if you have any questions for the cast, please prepare them.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I will be serving as the host this time, however...
it has been quite a while since my last media appearance.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, I'm actually quite nervous.
Please forgive any minor blunders.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...There was a critic who said
he would only appear on the show if I served as the host."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, they're probably joking, but
given my position, I can't exactly decline.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—We are challengers,
even now... you see.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —"Taking on the World"—that is one of the grand themes Umamusume racing strives toward.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Much like all other sports,
Umamusume racing has followed a path toward internationalization.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There are all kinds of races across the world.
What I'm about to introduce is just a small sample—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The livestream began.
At the viewing area—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her name suggests, Sirius Symboli is a member
of the Symboli household... and I've heard she's been close
with Speed Symboli since childhood.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah.
Stop treating me like a chick fresh out of the nest.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I just got curious about...
'how' she'd talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Where everything began, and where it all ended...
I found myself thinking of that time—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Setbacks, challenges, and romance...
The history of overseas campaigns is endlessly dramatic.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Beyond the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe awaits an unreached summit, driving us out into the world.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: However! Look at the current crop of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Environment, knowledge, experience... Through continuous evolution,
some Umamusume have even begun winning overseas.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“—Indeed, 'someday' is...
already here upon us.”

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now then, moving on...
Let us discuss where the Japanese racing world
should head from here.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We have invited commentators from various countries today.
First, allow me to introduce—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Toward the end of the stream, the discussion involving the critics was getting lively and intense.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, I see. As I thought,
establishing a base overseas for an ultra-long-term campaign is the absolute prerequisite for victory... is it?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Still, from a fan's perspective, you naturally want the Umamusume who made her mark in Japan to be the one taking the victory, right?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“—Especially if it is a summit where years of yearning have gathered.
How do you feel about that point,
Our champions...?”
choice_data_list: (So it comes down to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe after all...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while providing simultaneous interpretation, Speed Symboli's
flawless moderation heated up the atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That moment
arrived without warning.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Critic
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me,
would you be so kind
as to remind me...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Of course, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Critic
text_block_list.text:
What place did you finish in
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Critic
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure why Japan's so
focused on that race, but you
have come a long way since.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Critic
text_block_list.text:
With a bit more effort,
I think Japan's bound
to win it—someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a moment, I felt the air in the room freeze... but Speed Symboli simply smiled.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Is *that* your answer—Speed Symboli?
choice_data_list: Hey, what did you just say...?
Hey, what did you just say...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "It just means we were completely made fools of."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —"What place did you finish in the Arc?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's been trying hard since back then.
Hope they make it to the top someday"... or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the stream ended...
The final critic's words caused quite a stir
even among the fans—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is so frustrating~~!
Is that all Japan amounts to in the eyes of the world?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: "No, no, no, no! The girls in the Twinkle Series are already plenty amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Right!?
<chrname> and the others have been putting on such fiery races, too...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you lived overseas, right?
Nuance-wise, how did that come off?
Did it feel like they were making fun of me after all?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
No, it doesn't feel like they're making fun of me at all...
I think. That's why... it hits home even harder, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Huh, why?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Because... that just means Japanese Umamusume
aren't seen as a threat in the heartland of racing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A grimace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Though,
I prefer this to your usual straight face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Such lovely things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...To you, does my anger seem like nothing more than a baby's temper tantrum?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Anger, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "She doesn't really look like she's fired up, though."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in just wringing our hands in regret.
We must take measures to solve this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —To restore Speed Symboli's honor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...You felt something too, didn't you? Seeing Speed Symboli like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is that not why you came here?
If so, let me hear your opinion—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I remember now... You always
loved Speed Symboli, didn't you...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Good girl.
Try to remember what they held deep inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The glory she seeks... can only be found there.
